title: Ah, ah, ah, ah, questa è buona
subtitle: Don Giovanni, Leporello and Commendatore: recitative from Don Giovanni, Act 2

licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.notes: Words as printed in the Schirmer vocal score.

licences.source: G. Schirmer vocal score, New York 1900 (plate 15147, IMSLP #68957), pages 239–244 (89 bars)
licences.author: G. Schirmer, piano reduction as printed
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages by one reader, checked bar by bar by a separate fresh checker, then checked again against the print here; every bar of every part adds up. The English singing translation and the stage directions are left out. Secco recitative: the keyboard is written as the piano. Playback tempo: free, as recitative is sung; played here at a speaking pace, recitative ♩ = 91, from the median length of 2 recordings (Fricsay 3:48, Davis 4:14) after allowing about 34 seconds for the Commendatore's two Adagio entries, which are played at ♩ = 50 (estimated).
